doubts.claim_under_doubt: classify_generated_only's reuse of is_generated_path is a safe carve-out for any combination of changed paths that classifier accepts
doubts.finding: The classifier reused is_generated_path wholesale, which includes _GENERATED_AGENT_DOCS (build_dashboard.md, session_handoff.md, triage_inbox.md) -- files this repo's own agent-instruction surface, read back as agent context in later sessions. A PR touching only those would have skipped review entirely, converting a pre-existing forced-human-review case into a fully automated green for exactly the files most in need of eyes.
doubts.fix: Added pr_review_generated.is_safe_to_skip_review, a strictly narrower function excluding _GENERATED_AGENT_DOCS; classify_generated_only now calls it instead of is_generated_path. Regression tests in test_pr_review_generated_skip_review.py.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the basename-only matches (triage.jsonl, shipwright_events.jsonl, etc.) are an acceptable input to a full review-skip decision
doubts.finding: Those matches were directory-agnostic, so a brand-new file merely named e.g. triage.jsonl at an attacker-chosen path would classify as skip-safe.
doubts.fix: is_safe_to_skip_review anchors the four basenames to their one canonical repo-root path via _SKIP_REVIEW_CANONICAL_BASENAME_PATHS. Regression test: test_an_off_canonical_path_with_a_generated_basename_is_NOT_safe_to_skip.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: decide_gate's test/docstring treat 'timed_out' as a real GitHub Actions step outcome value
doubts.finding: GitHub Actions step outcomes are exactly success/failure/cancelled/skipped; there is no timed_out (a step timeout surfaces as cancelled).
doubts.fix: Replaced 'timed_out' in the test parametrization with an explicitly-labeled placeholder and a comment explaining the real outcome vocabulary.

concurrency_and_reversibility: attacked (force-push race, step-output timing, crash-then-silent-success) and came up clean -- the existing stale-head/impostor-check-run guards and the fail-open-only-on-crash design hold.
verification: Full shipwright-security plugin suite re-run after all three fixes: 1015 passed, 7 pre-existing skips. Lint clean. Test hygiene probe: no findings.
